blocks.p: Draw amounts will be $500 per sold job that has moved to Signed Contract.
Draw program extends for a period of 12 weeks from the date you graduated sales training.
Draws request are to be emailed to draws@shingleusa.com by Wednesday for that Fridays payroll. Texts message, phone calls or in person conversations are not acceptable.
A sales representative must have knocked on 150 doors the week prior and should have no files in “Sales Rep Fix” to qualify to receive a draw.
Repayment will be 25% of any regular commissions and 100% of any bonus dollars until all draws are repaid.
Resign or released from the company and 100% of commissions are held until all draws are repaid.
The dollar amounts are based on inspections that were completed in any given work week (Monday through Sunday) and not on inspections written.
You should write more than 10 in case you lose some to people who change their minds.
Each Storm Damaged roof that is setup with the Public Adjuster and a claim is filed receives $50
Each sales is calculated with the estimated commission percentage and paid the following Friday provided it has moved to Signed Contract.
